question: Who are identified as belonging to the wives of the yakshas?
premises: The wives of yakshas are named as a group
Those belonging to the three cities are included
Young attendants and others are included
inference: The Traipuras and the Baṭukas and others are associated with the wives of the yakshas.
uncertainties: The exact ritual role of these groups is not specified in this verse
plain_english: The Traipuras and the Baṭukas and others are said to belong to the wives of the yakshas.
